host.description: Hostname or IP address of the SSH server

private_key.description: Private key in OpenSSH or PEM format (RSA, ECDSA or Ed25519), including the BEGIN/END lines

passphrase.description: Passphrase of the private key, if it is encrypted

password.description: Password, used when no private key is given

host_key_fingerprint.description: Expected SHA256 fingerprint of the server's host key (e.g. SHA256:abc...). Leave empty to accept any host key; the observed fingerprint is returned in the action results so you can pin it.

description: Run commands and scripts on remote hosts over SSH. Designed to be executed on-premises with a playbook runner.
name: SSH Remote Execution
